name: Codync
description: Open source Grok Bot alternative, Bring your own agent and subscription: message Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot and 40+ AI agents as bots on your own computer, from iPhone, Mac, Windows, Linux or terminal. Agent-agnostic and free. Also a Muse and Dots alternative. Built in Rust.

capability_evidence.remote-control: help, approval cards, per-bot memory, remote screen, voice calls and "needs you / done" notifications — the same features, without being tied to one model or one subscription.
capability_evidence.mobile-access: > **Why the iPhone app can be a version behind:** every iPhone release goes through Apple's App Review first, which usually takes a day or more, so the App Store version can trail the Mac, Windows, Linux and host releas…
capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: other visible bots and message one; the reply comes back to it as a new turn, and it answers you then.
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: Codync turns the coding agents on your computer — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, OpenCode, Grok Build, Gemini, Copilot, Hermes Agent and ~40 more — into persistent *bots* you delegate to from your iPhone, Mac, Windows…
capability_evidence.mcp-support: in its own session, and can react to each other, up to 3 rounds.
capability_evidence.security-isolation: ut being tied to one model or one subscription.
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: OS, Windows and Linux (static on Linux, runs on any distro) that drives every agent, keeps the transcripts and serves every client.
capability_evidence.notifications: 40 more — into persistent *bots* you delegate to from your iPhone, Mac, Windows PC, Linux desktop or any terminal, the way you'd message a colleague.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot

friction.note_en: Turnkey. install via uvx one-liner, Homebrew install; configure sign-in required, database dependency; GUI application
friction.note_zh: 开箱即用。可通过 uvx one-liner、Homebrew install 安装；需配置 sign-in required、database dependency；GUI application

highlights: codync-host (Rust, macOS, Windows and Linux) runs on your computer.
Built in Rust. codync-host is one small, fast Rust binary for macOS, Windows and Linux (static on Linux, runs on any distro) that drives every agent, keeps the transcripts and serves every…
Push goes through a tiny relay that holds the APNs key.
One app per kind of device. Native SwiftUI on the iPhone, one desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux (Electron), and a terminal UI for SSH.
